title: Are Buy Now Pay Later Loans a Good Idea?
summary: Educational sketch video explains how BNPL late fees, merchant fees, and spending psychology work using an exaggerated sandwich-financing bit.

assertions.quote: you're only asked for a fraction of the price at the point of sale and the rest is paid off in a few biweekly installments
The Truth in Lending Act, which protects you from unfair or inaccurate credit practices, doesn't apply to Buy Now, Pay Later.
Most BNPL companies don't report on-time payments to the credit bureaus, which means they're not a viable way to build your credit history.
using BNPL loans increases one's spending habit by $60 a week
the fees are three to four times higher than those from credit card companies
